statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The diagnosis code for supraventricular tachycardia is I47.1
The diagnosis code for transient cerebral ischemic attacks is G45.9
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
This monitoring is critical for managing the patient's cardiac rhythm disturbances and preventing further ischemic events
